title: Request for Information (RFI) for Data Pipeline So
agency: SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION.SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION.SSA OFC OF ACQUISITION  GRANTS
description_text: RFI to gather vendor information for Data Pipeline Solution with capabilities for extensive log creation and retention, aggregation of data into a single stream with capacity for freely exchanged information from multiple systems, and layered security to the agency's log streams, accessible only through decryption from authorized users.
